facts.text: A dataset is a large collection of recorded and labeled sensor data shared by researchers; a benchmark is a dataset plus an agreed scoring rule that allows different methods to be compared on the same test.
facts.quote: A dataset is a large collection of recorded and labeled sensor data that researchers share, and a benchmark is a dataset plus an agreed scoring rule, so that different methods can be compared on the same test.

facts.text: MOCS (2021) contains 41,668 images from 174 construction sites with 13 object classes.
facts.quote: MOCS (2021) has 41,668 images from 174 construction sites with 13 object classes

facts.text: MOCS and SODA are image-only datasets captured from fixed or aerial viewpoints rather than a machine-mounted multi-sensor rig.
facts.quote: both are image-only, shot from fixed or aerial viewpoints rather than a machine-mounted multi-sensor rig

facts.text: RELLIS-3D and RUGD are machine-mounted off-road datasets; GOOSE and TartanDrive are also listed, but were not verified in the research.
facts.quote: RELLIS-3D and RUGD are machine-mounted off-road datasets, with GOOSE and TartanDrive, not verified in the research

facts.text: No validation for off-road collision warning was found for the listed off-road datasets RELLIS-3D, RUGD, GOOSE and TartanDrive.
facts.quote: RELLIS-3D and RUGD are machine-mounted off-road datasets, with GOOSE and TartanDrive, not verified in the research, and none was found validated for off-road collision warning

facts.text: Simulated data compared against RELLIS-3D showed large domain-shift effects.
facts.quote: Simulated data compared against RELLIS-3D showed large domain-shift effects

facts.text: A 2025 mining dataset contains 30,000 lidar frames from a haul truck, more than 80% of them dusty, and shows state-of-the-art detectors degrading in dust.
facts.quote: a 2025 set of 30,000 lidar frames from a haul truck, more than 80% dusty, shows state-of-the-art detectors degrading in dust

facts.text: SimMining-3D is a synthetic lidar dataset built because sensor height on mine benches degrades detection.
facts.quote: SimMining-3D is a synthetic lidar set built because sensor height on mine benches degrades detection

facts.text: The Waymo Open Dataset is an on-road example illustrating that a reproducible reference needs synchronized lidar and camera data, calibration, vehicle poses and tracked labels.
facts.quote: The Waymo Open Dataset, an on-road example, illustrates what a reproducible reference needs: synchronized lidar and camera, calibration, vehicle poses and tracked labels

facts.text: No public mining or construction adverse-weather dataset suited to sensor-model validation exists, so the manufacturer must collect its own dataset.
facts.quote: No public mining or construction adverse-weather dataset suited to sensor-model validation exists, so the manufacturer must collect its own

facts.text: The existing warning fleet is the one large source of off-road sensor recordings the manufacturer already owns.
